comment: save.c savelev_core() -> save_stairs() and restore.c getlev() -> rest_stairs() for the hero's level on #save and restore. A Priest steps off the D:1 up staircase and saves. The restored map draws that staircase through display.c back_to_glyph() -> stairs.c known_branch_stairs(), which needs the restored stairway's tolev and u_traversed to pick S_brupstair (yellow). The second segment walks back onto the staircase and looks with ':', so look_here() -> stairs_description() names the way out of the dungeon. Seeds, datetimes, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
